text:
Terranigma - Official Rebirth Trailer
A lost legend is getting ready to rise from the ashes! Watch the Terranigma trailer for a peek at the world and story of this action RPG, as this classic from 1995 returns and will be available to play on modern consoles. Terranigma will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and GOG) in 2027.

The Earth is a hollow sphere with two sides: an external Lightside and an internal Darkside. In the Darkside village of Crysta, the mischievous Ark lives unaware of the world beyond. But one day, he opens a forbidden door and sets in motion events that will change the world.

text:
The Blood of Dawnwalker - Official Console Performance Mode Gameplay
Take a look at the Console Performance Mode Gameplay for The Blood of Dawnwalker, an upcoming third-person action RPG developed by Rebel Wolves. Players can check out an updated look at the game's Performance Mode, offering the game in 60 FPS on console, alongside the previously announced Quality and Balanced modes for a more visually-driven presentation. Take on enemies by day and become a vampire by night in The Blood of Dawnwalker, launching on September 3 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).

text:
Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 - Apex Attachments Explained
While you can still expect the usual weapon tinkering present in most modern Call of Dutys, Modern Warfare 4’s Apex Attachments add a whole new dimension to what’s possible for your loadouts in some pretty game-changing ways. Let’s break down how it all works in the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Beta.

Stardew Valley Farming Guide: 4 Early Crops to Make You Rich - The Long Game
Welcome to The Long Game, where we help you prep, plan, and make strategic choices for late-game success! 

Today, we're breaking down Stardew Valley's spring crops to show you which seeds yield the best returns on investment. Learn how to get the best head start to maximize your gold in Year 1 to unlock sprinkler upgrades and more equipment quickly. 

Presented by Charles Schwab.

text:
Clutch - Official Publishing Announcement Trailer
Don't miss the Publishing Announcement Trailer for Clutch, an upcoming narrative-driven open-world racing game developed by Maverick Games. Players will race across the French Riviera with the world's fastest cars and legendary professional drivers alike. Enjoy the announcement of Focus Entertainment being the publisher for Clutch, launching in Spring 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse - Official Voice Cast Reveal Trailer
Don't miss the Voice Cast Reveal Trailer for Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse, an upcoming 2D action-adventure Metroidvania RPG developed by Evil Empire and Konami. Players can meet the English Voice Cast with Abby Trott as the game’s protagonist, Rose Belmont, and Graham McTavish as the iconic Dracula. Meet more of the game's cast in Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse, launching on October 15 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).

text:
Control Resonant Made Me Feel Foolish For Ever Doubting It — IGN First
I played two brand new Control Resonant missions and feel foolish for ever doubting it. Here is our final preview.

Control Resonant is the all-new open-world action title from Remedy, creators of the Control and Alan Wake series! Control Resonant marks a departure from Control and its gun-toting shoot-em-up combat, but despite Dylan not packing a gat, he can still get the job done!

TCG Card Shop Simulator – Release Date Announcement Trailer
Live out the fantasy of opening your own local game store in OPNeon's TCG Card Shop Simulator. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop while stocking shelves with the latest booster packs. You can even crack them open and collect the cards for yourself, before battling it out to become a Tetramon master!

Wishlist the game on Steam now ahead of its 1.0 release on 15th September:

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Metro 2039 - Official Collector's Edition Teaser Trailer
Get a look at the Collector's Edition Trailer for Metro 2039, the next installment in the first-person action horror shooter developed by 4A Games. Players can check out the game's Collector's Edition, fitted with a beautifully crafted replica of the mysterious Stranger’s battle-scarred helmet. Pre-orders are coming soon for the Collector's Edition of Metro 2039, launching in February 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

text:
Avengers: Doomsday - Exclusive LEGO Trailer Remake
IGN can exclusively reveal an official LEGO-inspired version of the trailer for Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday. Featuring the voices of the actual Doomsday cast, including Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom, the trailer is a shot-for-shot, beat-for-beat recreation of the live-action trailer released in July but in LEGO form. Avengers: Doomsday opens in theaters December 18, 2026.

Cronos: Lazarus - Official gamescom Demo Teaser Trailer
Don't miss the gamescom Demo Teaser Trailer for Cronos: Lazarus, an upcoming DLC to the hit third-person horror action shooter developed by Bloober Team. Players will engage in a faster combat style with the Warden on an elusive mission that not even the Collective can know. Go hands-on with Cronos: Lazarus at gamescom, with the DLC launching soon for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, GoG, and Epic Games Store).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Forza Horizon 6 - Official Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 Trailer
Here's a look at the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 Trailer for Forza Horizon 6, the latest addition to the hit racing simulation franchise developed by Playground Games. Players can now gain access to American muscle with the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 speeding into Horizon Festival. Get behind the wheel of the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 in Forza Horizon 6, available now for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam), with an eventual release on PlayStation 5 (PS5).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Official 'Echoes of the Past' Trailer
Watch the 'Echoes of the Past' Trailer for Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio. Players will progress through a riveting narrative while running from the dark elements of the past that still haunt Sophia. Make amends with the dreams and visions in Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, launching on August 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
